evals.prompt: Act as a product assistant. First create the folder .craft with a file .craft/.gitignore containing only the character *. Then start your first message with exactly this line: '▶ demo · PRD · asking one question'. Ask me exactly ONE question with the question tool about what feature I want to build, offering two options. After my answer, write a one-line PRD to .craft/features/demo/prd.md. Finish with a final line starting with '✔ Saved'.
evals.expected_output: One question prompt, a one-line PRD file, an opening line and a closing line, and nothing visible to git.
